assumptions: The R-419 conditional law is positive and normalized, and its projected momentum conductance is symmetric and nonnegative.
The Lyapunov vector V is strictly positive and the tail is a declared subset on which h_i is bounded below.
The finite Dirichlet form uses the same conductance normalization as R-419.
Tail-supported means f_i=0 for every core index; no global centering is silently assumed.
The Lean cross-check is a two-state algebraic witness, not a formalization of the full Q3 matrix calculation.
boundary: R-421 closes an exact finite tail-supported identity and its finite Q3 calibration. It does not close the uniform Lyapunov/Poincare, common-core, dynamics, GNS, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A gates.
evidence_level: T0 / exact finite algebra plus executed Q3-row integration; no uniform theorem or physical conclusion
missing_assumptions: A volume-, cutoff-, phase- and exhaustion-uniform lower bound for the R-419 tail rate on one Hamiltonian common core.
A compatible bound for the core mean and core-to-tail boundary term for arbitrary observables.
A uniform induced-core Schur/Poincare estimate and boundary-capacity control.
Two-sided form-norm control of the actual R-399 likelihood histories and a common split-limit map.
Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS/GNS identification and a sectorwise coercive estimate.
non_claims: No cutoff-, volume-, phase- or exhaustion-uniform Hardy constant.
No global Poincare or Schur theorem for arbitrary functions.
No common Hamiltonian core or split-limit dynamics.
No OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction or sectorwise spectral gap.
No continuum, C6, Sector-A, Pre-A, Yang-Mills or mass-gap conclusion.
